name: Gustling
notes: Gustling: a round blue chick with a white face and belly, an orange beak and a head crest. Type FLYING: it always flies, wings flapping and feet tucked away, in every animation (only the look; it moves and gets hit like the others). Moves: Gust (A), Peck (B) and Fly (R). Walks at 80 % speed: its move 1 (Gust) reaches 3 tiles, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: GUSTLING
